description: DATABASE/SCHEMA/COLLATION/CONVERSION lifecycle acceptance on postgresql17 (#118): native exec of the documented lifecycle chain plus pinned audit answers for every inventory shape.

ddl_steps.name: create database with options
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE DATABASE t35_app WITH OWNER = t35_owner ENCODING 'UTF8' TEMPLATE template0

verify.sql: SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname='t35_app'

ddl_steps.name: alter database set parameter
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER DATABASE t35_app SET timezone TO 'UTC'

ddl_steps.name: alter database rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER DATABASE t35_app RENAME TO t35_app2

verify.sql: SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname='t35_app2'
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_database WHERE datname='t35_app2'
SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name='t35_app'

ddl_steps.name: create schema with elements
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SCHEMA t35_el CREATE TABLE t (id int)

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='t35_el' AND table_name='t'

ddl_steps.name: alter schema rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SCHEMA t35_app RENAME TO t35_app2

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name IN ('t35_app2','t35_el')

ddl_steps.name: alter collation rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER COLLATION t35_german2 RENAME TO t35_german3

ddl_steps.name: create conversion
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE CONVERSION t35_conv FOR 'LATIN1' TO 'UTF8' FROM iso8859_1_to_utf8

ddl_steps.name: alter conversion rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER CONVERSION t35_conv RENAME TO t35_conv2

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_conversion WHERE conname='t35_conv2'

post_state_check.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_database WHERE datname='t35_neg'
